originalTitle: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: Here's Why
summary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) closed at $9.14 in the latest trading session, marking a -2.35% move from the prior day.
content:
PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) closed the most recent trading day at $9.14, moving -2.35% from the previous trading session. The stock's performance was behind the S&P 500's daily gain of 0.62%. Meanwhile, the Dow gained 0.28%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, added 1.3%.

Heading into today, shares of the company had gained 4% over the past month, outpacing the Business Services sector's gain of 1.32% and the S&P 500's gain of 2.3%.

Analysts and investors alike will be keeping a close eye on the performance of PagSeguro Digital Ltd. in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company is predicted to post an EPS of $0.4, indicating a 17.65% growth compared to the equivalent quarter last year. Meanwhile, the latest consensus estimate predicts the revenue to be $1.05 billion, indicating a 17.55% increase compared to the same quarter of the previous year.

PAGS's full-year Zacks Consensus Estimates are calling for earnings of $1.69 per share and revenue of $4.25 billion. These results would represent year-over-year changes of +19.01% and +16.27%, respectively.

It's also important for investors to be aware of any recent modifications to analyst estimates for PagSeguro Digital Ltd. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. As such, positive estimate revisions reflect analyst optimism about the business and profitability.

Research indicates that these estimate revisions are directly correlated with near-term share price momentum. To exploit this, we've formed the Zacks Rank, a quantitative model that includes these estimate changes and presents a viable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which ranges from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has an impressive outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks generating an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 0.44% lower. PagSeguro Digital Ltd. currently has a Zacks Rank of #4 (Sell).

Valuation is also important, so investors should note that PagSeguro Digital Ltd. has a Forward P/E ratio of 5.55 right now. For comparison, its industry has an average Forward P/E of 13.6, which means PagSeguro Digital Ltd. is trading at a discount to the group.

Also, we should mention that PAGS has a PEG ratio of 0.46. The PEG ratio is akin to the commonly utilized P/E ratio, but this measure also incorporates the company's anticipated earnings growth rate. The Financial Transaction Services industry had an average PEG ratio of 0.91 as trading concluded yesterday.

The Financial Transaction Services industry is part of the Business Services sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 157, this industry ranks in the bottom 37% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The strength of our individual industry groups is measured by the Zacks Industry Rank, which is calculated based on the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within these groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Remember to apply Zacks.com to follow these and more stock-moving metrics during the upcoming trading sessions.

chineseTitle: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) 股票随着市场上涨而下跌：原因如下
chineseSummary: PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) 在最新交易日收于 9.14 美元，较前一日上涨 -2.35%。
chineseContent:
PagSeguro Digital Ltd. (PAGS) 最近一个交易日收盘价为 9.14 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -2.35%。该股的表现落后于标准普尔 500 指数每日涨幅 0.62%。与此同时，道指上涨 0.28%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.3%。

截至今天，该公司股价在过去一个月上涨了 4%，超过了商业服务板块 1.32% 的涨幅和标准普尔 500 指数 2.3% 的涨幅。

分析师和投资者都将密切关注 PagSeguro Digital Ltd. 在即将发布的收益披露中的表现。该公司预计每股收益为 0.4 美元，较去年同期增长 17.65%。与此同时，最新的共识预测收入为10.5亿美元，较去年同期增长17.55%。

PAGS 的全年 Zacks 共识预计每股收益为 1.69 美元，收入为 42.5 亿美元。这些结果将分别代表+19.01%和+16.27%的同比变化。

对于投资者来说，了解 PagSeguro Digital Ltd 分析师预测的任何最新修改也很重要。这些修改通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，而这些趋势可能会经常变化。因此，积极的估计修正反映了分析师对业务和盈利能力的乐观态度。

研究表明，这些估计修正与近期股价动能直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们形成了 Zacks Rank，这是一个定量模型，其中包括这些估计变化并提供了一个可行的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），具有令人印象深刻的外部审计表现优异记录，自 1988 年以来#1 股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计下降了 0.44%。 PagSeguro Digital Ltd . 目前的 Zacks 排名为#4（销售）。

估值也很重要，因此投资者应注意 PagSeguro Digital Ltd. 目前的远期市盈率为 5.55。相比之下，该行业的平均远期市盈率为 13.6，这意味着 PagSeguro Digital Ltd. 的交易价格低于该集团。

另外，我们应该提到 PAGS 的 PEG 比率为 0.46。 PEG比率类似于常用的市盈率，但该指标还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天交易结束，金融交易服务行业的平均 PEG 率为 0.91。

金融交易服务行业是商业服务行业的一部分。目前该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 157，在所有行业中排名垫底 37%，数量超过 250 个。

我们各个行业组的实力是通过 Zacks 行业排名来衡量的，该排名是根据这些组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名计算的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
